title: Preorder representatives retaining an embedded poset
statement: Let J be a nonempty partial order, I a directed preorder, and e:J↪oI an order embedding, all in Type w. There is a nonempty directed partial order M in Type w, embeddings r:M↪oI and d:J↪oM with d.trans(r)=e, and for every i∈I there exists m∈M with i≤r(m) and r(m)≤i.

source.place: Tag 00YP, proof of lemma-refine-all-at-once; strict refinements preceding Tag 00YO

proof.text: Take M to be the antisymmetrization of I. The composite d of e with the quotient map is injective: equality of its values means e(j)≤e(j′) and conversely, hence j=j′ by the embedding and antisymmetry of J. It preserves and reflects order.

source.place: Tag 00YP, proof of lemma-refine-all-at-once; strict refinements preceding Tag 00YO

proof.text: Define r by extending the prescribed values r(d(j))=e(j) to the other quotient classes using Mathlib’s representative function. Its quotient is the identity, so r preserves and reflects order. The old embedding is fixed exactly. An upper bound in I for two representatives gives an upper bound of their classes in M. Every i is equivalent to the representative of its own class.
